user.title: Connect to OpenWrt Router
user.description: Provide the ubus JSON-RPC connection details for your OpenWrt router.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to OpenWrt router. Check IP address, port, and network reachability.
error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed. Check your OpenWrt username and password.

profile_select.title: Select Profile
profile_select.description: Choose a profile to edit or select '+ Add New Profile'.

profile_edit.title: Configure Profile
profile_edit.description: Set member name and select assigned devices to manage (schedule times are controlled directly on the device card).

error.invalid_mac: Invalid MAC address format. Expected format like AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.

pause_profile.name: Pause Internet Access
pause_profile.description: Temporarily or indefinitely blocks internet access for all devices in a parental profile.

profile_id.name: Profile ID
profile_id.description: The ID of the parental control profile to pause.

duration.name: Pause Duration
duration.description: How long to pause internet access.

entry_id.name: Config Entry ID
entry_id.description: Target router instance ID (optional if only one OpenWrt router is configured).

resume_profile.name: Resume Internet Access
resume_profile.description: Manually unpauses internet access for a parental profile.

profile_id.name: Profile ID
profile_id.description: The ID of the parental control profile to resume.

entry_id.name: Config Entry ID
entry_id.description: Target router instance ID (optional if only one router configured).

set_profile_enabled.name: Set Profile Rule Enforcement
set_profile_enabled.description: Toggles whether rules (schedule and pauses) are enforced or bypassed.

profile_id.name: Profile ID
profile_id.description: The ID of the parental control profile.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: True to enforce rules; False to bypass all rules for this profile.

save_profile.name: Save or Update Profile
save_profile.description: Creates a new parental control profile or updates an existing one.

profile_id.name: Profile ID
profile_id.description: Optional ID (leave blank to auto-generate a new profile).

mac_addresses.name: Device MAC Addresses
mac_addresses.description: List of MAC addresses assigned to this profile.

is_enabled.name: Enforce rules
is_enabled.description: Whether this profile's restrictions are active.

schedule.name: Weekly block schedule
schedule.description: Schedule object with active_days, start_time, stop_time, and enabled.

delete_profile.name: Delete Profile
delete_profile.description: Removes a parental control profile and unbinds its network rules.
